label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 88
title: Operate/Grow/Engage views (stages 13-13b)
body:
## Original (as captured)
Dashboard counterpart for the pipeline-phases program.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0112)
Post-delivery phase after 12; enabled per project by the tailoring step.
13 Operate & Observability - MAIN observer + post-production, maintenance, performance; artifact ops-report.md.
13a Customer Success & Support - MAIN customer-success [NEW] + customer-onboarding; artifact customer-success-playbook.md.
13b Growth, Engagement & Feedback - MAIN growth [NEW] + community-social [NEW], marketing, analyst, insight-extractor; artifact growth-plan.md.
depends_on: 13<-12, 13a<-13, 13b<-13,13a.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).
